Fubbit has proposed to Kaguya. To reject him, Kaguya keeps\non setting difficult conditions for him. Find a\n"Huge Branch" for the "Gemstone Branch" before he does!
You've got the "Huge Branch" for the "Gemstone Branch"!\nNext, collect 3 "White Stones", 3 "Blue Stones", and\n3 "Green Stones" to attach to the branch!
Fubbit who has lost the dance battle wants to take Kaguya to\nUraluna by force. Defeat Fubbit to protect Kaguya!
